name: Sejima Seiya
source:
The Hero

Profession: Cook
Birthplace: Tokyo, Japan
Race: Human

A man from another world. He had turned twenty without once having done it, so he got concerned.

Due to a certain incident, he finds himself flung into the parallel world of Laurentide.
Although he's never gone all the way with a woman before, he finds himself at the center of of a prophecy that is attracting many beautiful suitors. His mission is to have as much baby-making sex as possible!
